wounded.line: Everything stays down where it's wounded
stanza: I was thinking of a series of dreams
Where nothing comes up to the top
Everything stays down where it's wounded
And comes to a permanent stop
Like in a dream when someone wakes up and screams
Just thinking of a series of dreams

wounded.line: Well it's Father's Day and everybody's wounded
stanza: Ah remember me, I used to live for music (baby)
Remember me, I brought your groceries in (ooh baby yeah)
Well it's Father's Day and everybody's wounded
First we take Manhattan, then we take Berlin
